root: ^It worked! I was right! I am still the smartest fish around!
^I have already figured out the next task.
^It should be on your stone now.
^What??  I only just finished this task, can’t a cat have a nap??
^Oh. I’m not sure I like this question.
^I don’t necessarily mean some big guy up in the sky,  but do you believe in something...more?
^Personally, I believe everything can be explained with logic and reason.
^I find no use for spiritual beliefs.
^I don’t know...I’m still trying to find it. Eleni said the god will bring her guitar back
^But I think maybe everything happens for a reason...the things that happen to us...the people we meet.
^There could be some sort of spirit or being making it all happen.
